descriptionHtml:
Approach · OAT-01 Signing In & Session Security · S06 Session ceilings at their edges: 12 h idle and 30 days old

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U3 After 12 hours idle, the physician has to sign in again with an email OTP. (UAT OAT-01 step 3; UAT OAT-01 Expected; TFA-94513 AC 4) — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress
  • U4 At 30 days the session hard-expires, however active it is. On day 31, access needs a new email OTP. (UAT OAT-01 step 4; UAT OAT-01 Expected; TFA-94513 AC 5) — gate: blocked: TFA-94513 in progress

Test design technique: Boundary values (boundary) — Sit right on the edge of the rule (exactly on time / a minute late, empty, longest, most) and see on which side the behavior changes.

Given A fresh account signed in through the API for each case

When Read the new session's expiry. Backdate expiresAt to now - 1 s. Backdate to 10 min before expiry, then fetch a Convex token, then make a real get-session call. Backdate createdAt to exactly now - 30 d while expiresAt stays now + 11 h. Run the hourly sweep. Sign in with rememberMe:false.

Then A new session expires 12 h after creation (within 5 s). Past expiry, the next call is refused with 'session idle'. A token fetch does not move the expiry, but real use does. At exactly 30 days the next call is refused with 'session too_old' even though the session is active, and the session is deleted. …

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): api/session-security.spec.ts assertions, judged against U3 (12 h idle -> sign in again) and U4 (30 d regardless of activity). The inside edge (a session just under 30 days still works) is S07 cell (a).

Where it ran: local lane A (existing Playwright tests); test method API · API (Convex functions); lane planned in the matrix: existing tests (Tim's Playwright) (automated)

S06 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/OAT-01.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: local — main e02167f → 25acd727 (10-15/16 re-tests), local stack (not a deployed build); run folder runs/2026-10-14-local, lane A.

Test method: API · API (Convex functions); secondary: TIME · Time / aging (clock moved) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on local; Source: matrix (lane A).
